A beautifully crafted warm ivory cotton-paper envelope, opened just enough to reveal a single blank pale periwinkle-blue note card. A small circular deep ink-blue wax seal lies on the envelope front; seal has an elegant unlettered embossed fold motif, no letters. Envelope centered horizontally, slightly diagonal on a seamless warm matte paper backdrop precisely close to #f5f3ed. View at a refined three-quarter overhead angle, gentle window light from upper left, tactile paper fibres, natural creases, subtle irregular wax, soft realistic contact shadows. Envelope should occupy approximately 70 percent of width and 62 percent of height, with generous clear margins all sides. Quiet, personal, high-end stationery photography, authentic materials, restrained palette warm ivory #f5f3ed and blue #283f83, soft blue note #d5dce9. The image is a standalone object photograph, not a website or UI mockup. No text, no handwriting, no typography, no watermark, no logos, no human hands, no laptop, no coins, no stock branding, no black background, no neon, no busy props. Keep the envelope and note's silhouette clear at mobile size.

assets.name: envelope-front-v01
assets.purpose: Animated correspondence journey: realistic transparent envelope front
assets.prompt: Production asset for a scroll-animated premium stationery website. Generate ONLY the front paper shell of an open ivory cotton-paper envelope, isolated on a genuinely transparent alpha background. Use the reference for ivory paper texture, warm restrained material and blue-brand correspondence atmosphere, but remove all blue cards, wax seals, text and props. Straight-on orthographic view, no camera angle, no rotation, no perspective, symmetrical horizontal envelope. The front shell has a deep V-shaped open upper edge: the top-left and top-right corners are high, the upper edge dips to the middle about 50 percent down; the entire triangular opening above that V must be transparent so a separate note can slide behind it. Show the realistic left/right folded paper panels and bottom triangular folded panel, with tactile cotton fibers, subtle creases and delicate seam shadows. The outer envelope body is a neat horizontal rectangle about 1.75 times as wide as tall. Center it, occupying about 90 percent frame width, fully visible. Natural soft lighting from upper left, warm ivory #f5f0e4, authentic high-end paper detail. No back panel across the open V, no top flap, no insert, no seal, no logo, no printed words, no hands, no desk, no background color, no checkerboard pattern. This is one cutout layer, not a complete envelope, illustration, website or mockup. Clean alpha edges and no surrounding cast shadow.
assets.status: integrated; inspected in desktop, tablet and mobile whole-page journey
